/// <summary>未指定と明示した既定値を区別します。</summary>
public readonly struct Optional<T>
{
    private readonly T value;
    public Optional(T value) { this.value = value; HasValue = true; }
    public bool HasValue { get; }
    public T Value => HasValue ? value : throw new InvalidOperationException("Value was not specified");
    public static implicit operator Optional<T>(T value) => new(value);
}
/// <summary>外部 CALL の探索指定。通常は必ず Throw です。</summary>
public enum CallStubMode
{
/// <summary>到達した未実装 CALL を拒否します。</summary>
Throw,
/// <summary>生成された未実装 CALL だけを探索します。</summary>
NoOp,
}
/// <summary>COBOL の終了理由です。</summary>
public enum TerminationKind
{
/// <summary>本文末尾です。</summary>
Fallthrough,
/// <summary>呼出し元へ戻ります。</summary>
Goback,
/// <summary>run unit を終了します。</summary>
StopRun,
/// <summary>プログラムを終了します。</summary>
ExitProgram,
}
/// <summary>一回の実行の協調的制限です。</summary>
public sealed record ExecutionOptions
{
    public int? MaxSteps { get; init; }
    public int? TimeoutMs { get; init; }
    public CallStubMode CallStubMode { get; init; } = CallStubMode.Throw;
    public bool EnableBranchTrace { get; init; }
    public bool IsExploration { get; init; }
    public int MaxBranchEvents { get; init; } = 10000;
    internal void Validate()
    {
        if (MaxSteps is <= 0 || TimeoutMs is <= 0 || MaxBranchEvents <= 0 || !Enum.IsDefined(CallStubMode)) throw new ArgumentException("Invalid execution options");
    }
}
/// <summary>生成時の到達証跡。業務期待値と独立した不変コピーです。</summary>
public sealed record BranchEvent(string BranchId, string Outcome);
/// <summary>上限超過は不完全な証跡として明示します。</summary>
public sealed class BranchSnapshot
{
    public static BranchSnapshot Empty { get; } = new(Array.Empty<BranchEvent>(), false);
    public BranchSnapshot(IEnumerable<BranchEvent> events, bool truncated) { Events = Array.AsReadOnly(events.ToArray()); Truncated = truncated; }
    public IReadOnlyList<BranchEvent> Events { get; }
    public bool Truncated { get; }
}
internal sealed class BranchRecorder(ExecutionOptions options)
{
    private readonly List<BranchEvent> events = [];
    private readonly Dictionary<string, int> iterations = new();
    private readonly HashSet<string> activeLoops = new();
    private bool truncated;
    internal void Record(string id, string outcome)
    {
        if (!options.EnableBranchTrace) return;
        if (events.Count >= options.MaxBranchEvents) { truncated = true; return; }
        events.Add(new(id, outcome));
    }
    internal bool Test(string id, bool value, string yes = "true", string no = "false") { Record(id, value ? yes : no); return value; }
    internal void StartLoop(string id) { if (options.EnableBranchTrace) { iterations[id] = 0; activeLoops.Add(id); } }
    internal bool Loop(string id, bool continuing)
    {
        if (options.EnableBranchTrace)
        {
            if (continuing) { Record(id, "continue"); iterations.TryGetValue(id, out var count); iterations[id] = count + 1; }
            else FinishLoop(id);
        }
        return continuing;
    }
    internal void FinishLoop(string id)
    {
        if (!options.EnableBranchTrace || !activeLoops.Remove(id)) return;
        iterations.TryGetValue(id, out var count);
        Record(id, "end");
        Record(id, count == 0 ? "zero" : count == 1 ? "one" : "multiple");
    }
    internal void FinishOpenLoops() { foreach (var id in activeLoops.ToArray()) FinishLoop(id); }
    internal BranchSnapshot Snapshot() => new(events, truncated);
}

/// <summary>普通の C# シナリオだけを登録する runner の入口です。</summary>
public sealed class ScenarioRegistry
{
    private readonly Dictionary<(string Program, string Name), Func<ExecutionOptions, object>> cases = new();
    public void Register<TResult>(string programId, string name, Func<ExecutionOptions, TResult> run) where TResult : notnull
    {
        if (!cases.TryAdd((programId, name), options => run(options))) throw new ArgumentException("Duplicate scenario " + programId + "/" + name);
    }
    internal object Run(string programId, string name, ExecutionOptions options) => cases.TryGetValue((programId, name), out var run) ? run(options) : throw new ArgumentException("Unknown scenario. Available: " + string.Join(", ", cases.Keys));
}
/// <summary>runner と比較データだけの精密数値シリアライズです。</summary>
internal static class RunnerSerialization
{
    internal static System.Text.Json.JsonSerializerOptions Options
    {
        get
        {
            var options = new System.Text.Json.JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true };
            options.Converters.Add(new NumberConverter());
            return options;
        }
    }
    private sealed class NumberConverter : System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonConverter<Number>
    {
        public override Number Read(ref System.Text.Json.Utf8JsonReader reader, Type type, System.Text.Json.JsonSerializerOptions options) => throw new NotSupportedException("Use typed inputs or the legacy fixture adapter");
        public override void Write(System.Text.Json.Utf8JsonWriter writer, Number value, System.Text.Json.JsonSerializerOptions options)
        {
            writer.WriteStartObject();
            writer.WriteString("numerator", value.Numerator.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            writer.WriteString("denominator", value.Denominator.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            writer.WriteEndObject();
        }
    }
}
